text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Admire Groove and her classmates 
were learning about first aid during 
class.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! So that's how training mannequins are 
put together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Fine. I know it's fascinating, but 
we really need to get on with our 
assignment."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. Our group is the only 
one falling behind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Alv is sorry too. For making you wait.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It's fine. ...Let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...And then follow the voice prompts. 
Yeah, looks like there won't be any issues 
using the AED—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
T-Teacher? Are you all right? You look 
rather pale...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
...Eh...? I'm sorry... I couldn't really 
hear—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: !? Sensei...!?

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Sensei collapsed...!?" "I-Isn't 
this really bad!?" "What do we do, 
shouldn't we call an ambulance...!?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Keep quiet.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear my voice? ...Looks like 
you're conscious. No vomiting—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It looks mild, but we can't let our guard 
down. ...First, we need to place them in 
the shock position.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll help too! If I remember right, you 
elevate the legs higher than the head, 
right? Let's see, something we can put 
under the feet is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Alve! I got the first-aid kit 
ready...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... Is there anything else I can help 
you with...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Keep an eye on the other girls so they 
don't panic. I'll go fetch the nurse from 
the infirmary."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san, switch with me here. Be 
careful, as there might be injuries to 
other parts as well."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it! I'll get the first-aid 
supplies ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And after that, Admire Groove and the 
others tended to the teacher who had 
collapsed...”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
According to the nurse, it's just mild 
anemia. She'll rest a bit and then head to 
the hospital, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see! What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... thanks, Arv. For directing me on 
what to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I panicked. Because I couldn't do anything 
on my own...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I believe everyone fulfilled their roles, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Both you and Fine fulfilled everything 
that was necessary, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. Both Dober and I managed to 
stay calm and ask for instructions.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"That's why Alv was able to assign tasks 
so calmly. I'm sure we were able to help 
everyone."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If we've both done what we set out to do, 
then that's more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are we finished here? ...I'll take my 
leave now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: They're gone. ...Hehe, same as always.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Always calm and collected, never getting 
deeply involved with others—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yet at times like this, you always manage 
to pull it off♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...You can't help but think it, 
right? Like, "Wow, that's so cool."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have to stand proud and dignified too. 
So much that nothing can shake me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard a rumor today. Apparently Admire 
Groove and the others took proper action 
and helped a teacher who had collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing special. I only did what 
needed to be done.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure your classmates appreciate it 
too.

To think you even remembered all the 
first-aid steps...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. I've been thanked several 
times by the Umamusume in my group."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, that is all. They don't try to 
get any further involved with me... which 
is a relief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the Umamusume in that group also 
understood the proper distance to keep 
with her... Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It was covered in class, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you pay attention in class, 
this is content you should easily 
remember.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her perfectly matter-of-fact tone served 
as a fresh reminder of what an honor 
student of an Umamusume she truly was.
